description.value: Moo's Pizza is a local pizza shop on the Trans-Canada Highway in Cobble Hill, serving a broad menu of classic and gourmet pizzas available by phone order. With named house specials and several dedicated vegetarian pies, it offers a hearty refuelling option for cyclists riding the Cowichan Valley corridor of Vancouver Island.

address.value: 3345 Trans-Canada Highway, Unit 5, Cobble Hill, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and corroborates the OSM phone number (250-929-2811) and street address (3345 TCH, Unit 5), but the website footer explicitly states 'COBBLE HILL, BC' while OSM assigns the record to community 'Sidney'; the coordinates (48.680°N, 123.568°W) place the business in the Cobble Hill area, not Sidney, so the website is preferred for locality. Vegetarian pizza options (VEGETARIAN, GREEK, THE POPEYE, PRESTO PESTO, FOUR CHEESE) are explicitly listed on the menu. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycle-tourism infrastructure appears anywhere on the website.
